history: Invented in Connecticut in 1979. Widely known by an older name referencing the Troubles, which most bars have retired.
whyItWorks: The whiskey cuts the cream and the stout carries it — but the acid in the stout curdles the cream within seconds.
steps: Layer the Irish cream over the whiskey in a shot glass.
Half-fill a pint glass with stout.
Drop the shot in and drink it immediately — it curdles fast.
techniqueNotes: Drink it within seconds. This is not a drink you build and set down.
name: Irish Slammer
description: Irish whiskey and Irish cream dropped into stout.
